limits: Numerical evidence and conservative candidates, not verified cuts, camera movement, physical lighting, words, speaker identities or semantic actions. Video, audio, extracted frames and temporary signed CDN URLs are intentionally omitted.
timeMapping: Window source PTS are exact within that file. Middle/end clip times plus sourceOffsetSeconds are approximate original positions because those windows were re-encoded.

audioOnsets.limits: Attack candidates are differences between decoded-frame RMS envelopes, not sample-accurate acoustic onsets, beats, speech, music or identifiable SFX. Source PTS anchor marks the start of the *later* frame; the actual sound change may occur anywhere in the two-frame support window. A change from a negative-infinity RMS floor has no measurable dB delta. Frames across audio timestamp discontinuities are never compared. No independently verified alignment to video cuts or artistic approval is implied.

avCutEvidence.limits: Shared source bytes alone do not prove synchronized clocks, absence of priming/edit lists, musical beats, narration intent, causality or edit accuracy. Only fully contained audio frames are compared; a straddling frame is excluded.

editRhythm.limits: Only exact gaps between consecutive candidate cut PTS are measured. No claim is made about completed shots, cut intent, pace preference, film rhythm quality, or edits beyond the bounded scan.

analysis.limits: apparent image shift only; cannot identify camera versus object, parallax, zoom, or 3D motion

analyzer.limits: 2D short-baseline integer patch displacement only; affine is an image-plane fit, not physical zoom/rotation/camera recovery; groups and linked tracklets are not semantic identities; no occlusion recovery or 3D inference

method.limits: Proposals are not identified film techniques, verified lights, tracked objects, recovered camera rigs, author keyframes, story purpose or a quality grade. Missing stage data is not negative evidence.
